title: Servepath Latency Prism: per-route percentile breakdown and streaming-mode split
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a new route-focused latency dashboard (the 'Servepath Latency Prism') that surfaces p50/p95/p99 for each model+route, with an explicit split between streaming and non-streaming requests. This ticket covers: instrumentation review (tracing hooks + metrics), pipeline changes for SV & non-SV histograms, dashboard panels, and alertable SLI definitions. The primary goal is to give SREs and runtime engineers an at-a-glance compositor to identify tail regression vectors across serving paths.
background: We have a proliferation of narrow latency dashboards (percentiles by model, or overall route percentiles) but customers and SREs need a single surface that joins percentiles with IO-mode (streaming vs non-streaming), and links to trace hooks and example traces. Several incidents in Q3 showed regressions that only appeared in streaming p99s and were missed by aggregate panels.
acceptance_criteria: New dashboard page under Observability > Servepath Latency Prism is available to internal users
Per-route rows show p50, p95, p99, sample size, and streaming/non-streaming split columns
Each percentile value links to example traces (via trace_id) and to the trace waterfall view
Backend histogram ingestion supports separate streaming vs non-streaming buckets for percentiles within the pipeline (min overhead)
Dashboard supports filters: model, route, time window, customer-tier, region
Alert rules created for route-level p99 uplift (configurable thresholds) and noisy-routing churn
Documentation updated: instrumentation guide for adding trace hooks and marking requests as streaming
Performance impact of extra labels on metrics is within acceptable limits (<3% ingestion cost increase for heavy routes)
Playbook updated to include steps for investigating streaming-specific tail regressions
technical_notes: Instrumentation: ensure all serving runtime emit span attribute 'io.mode' set to 'stream' or 'sync' at request root span
Metrics: emit separate histogram metrics 'servepath.latency.histogram' with label 'io_mode' so we can compute percentiles per mode without cardinality explosion
Tracing hooks: add lightweight sampling link from panel to trace explorer; prefer head-based examples for streaming requests (first/last token latency) in the trace view
Pipeline: In the metrics pipeline, add a transformation that materializes per-route+model+io_mode summary (count, sum, 10/50/95/99 quantile sketches) for efficient dashboarding
Storage: store sketches in metrics-store namespace 'servepath_summaries.v1', retention 30d for alerting and 90d for trend analysis
Dashboard queries: p50/p95/p99 computed from stored sketches (or histogram quantile when available) to avoid full raw-timeseries scans
Backfilling: run a 7-day backfill job to populate the new summaries from raw metrics for immediate context
Cost control: only materialize summaries for top-k routes by QPS, and for routes flagged as 'customer facing' to limit ingestion growth
Compatibility: support routes served by Dedicated and Private deployments; fall back to aggregated route if io_mode label missing
Security: dashboard links to traces must respect RBAC; ensure private deployment traces are not accessible via hosted console
dashboard_panels: Overview heatmap: routes (rows) x percentiles (columns: p50/p95/p99) colored by absolute latency
IO-mode split bar: per-route stacked bars showing p95 for streaming vs non-streaming
Tail trend timeseries: selectable percentile (p50/p95/p99) for chosen route with annotations for deploys
Trace sampler list: top anomalous traces for selected route+io_mode with quick links to trace explorer
Sample distribution histogram: overlay of streaming vs non-streaming latency distributions for chosen route
Traffic and error context: QPS, error-rate, and input-size median to correlate latency shifts
queries_examples: Sketch-based p95: SELECT quantile_approx(p95, 0.95) FROM servepath_summaries WHERE route='{route}' AND model='{model}' AND io_mode='stream' AND ts >= now() - 1h
Streaming ratio: SELECT count_if(io_mode='stream')/count(*) FROM requests WHERE route='{route}' AND ts >= now() - 1h
Tail alert source: SELECT route, model, p99 FROM servepath_summaries WHERE p99 > {threshold} AND ts >= now() - 5m
alerts_and_slos: SLO candidate: route-level p95 < 250ms for text-generation-small models (non-stream), p95 < 500ms for stream-mode; target availability 99.9%
Alert: route_p99_uplift_high — fires when route p99 > baseline_p99 * 1.6 AND absolute p99 > 1000ms for 5m
Alert: streaming_p99_degradation — streaming p99 rises by >200ms vs baseline for 10m
Pager policy: alerts page on-call SRE and owning service engineer; include playbook link and top 3 traces
